overview_description.description: TAI offers a complete software solution for life companies to self-report all their reinsurance information; assumed, ceded or retroceded in an electronic format to share with their trading partners on a cost effective basis. They are dedicated to their client relationships and value them beyond the periodic upgrades to their System. They have over 100 customers that represent all sizes of Life Insurance companies  and reinsurance programs.
